_comment: Default file-icon theme. Values are icon names resolving to assets/{ns}/ui/icons/{name}.svg. A resource pack overrides this by shipping the same path.
_icons: IntelliJ Platform icons, 2023 'New UI' set (Apache 2.0, JetBrains s.r.o.) -- see ui/icons/ATTRIBUTION.md. They carry their own palette, so filetypes.css does NOT tint them; it colours the row label and anything monochrome. A theme that wants them flattened to one colour can say icon("...", monochrome) in CSS.
_variants: Each icon ships twice, as name.svg and name_dark.svg. The theme names only the stem; FileIconTheme.withVariant appends the suffix for the active variant and falls back to the stem when an icon has no dark drawing. Do NOT list _dark names here.
_grouping: A key may list several names separated by commas -- "png, jpg, jpeg" is exactly equivalent to three entries. They are split at load, so each still matches on its own and still gets its own .filetype-* class; grouping is shorthand for whoever writes the file, not a concept the engine carries.
_gap: An entry resolving to 'text' below is one with no icon yet -- that is the outstanding list, and it is deliberately readable straight off this file rather than restated in a comment that would go stale. Most live in per-language IntelliJ PLUGIN modules rather than the Platform; GLSL has no JetBrains icon at all. They are listed anyway, because listing them is what gives each its own .filetype-* class for the cascade to colour, so a Kotlin file can differ from a Rust one on the label today. Replace the value as an icon arrives; nothing else has to change.
